Needs changes before merge. Two documentation items block this PR. The code checks passed.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs:28` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:349`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the 2D Offset Passes control and the 2D Pocket Boundary controls. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to this PR branch.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:152`: Add the line `Process change: yes` to the PR body. This PR changes a process file. Current upstream `AGENTS.md` requires this declaration. Do not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; the merging session changes it.

## What passed

- The trial merge is clean. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head.
- Protected 2D Pocket generation, verification and posting passed the end-to-end tests.
- The full-tool, overhead-lift, rest, pre-drilled entry and KeepDown checks passed.
- No recorded programs, fixtures or goldens changed. The body states `Goldens moved: none`, which agrees with the diff.

## Local build and test results

Reviewed head: `9606cf508050843e7a7fce292ffc715e7f099b67`.
Upstream main: `6e641dac753020bfed49fec310237eed28448141`.
Local trial merge: `346c77885668fec80186754b3a52ca97785e7354`.
Rules: current upstream main's `AGENTS.md` and UI addendum.
Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-3516`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 408 steps, 0 failures, 0 stalls; 55.4 minutes |
| Quick motion tests | 1166 passed, 54 ignored |
| Quick app tests | 2422 passed, 25 ignored |
| Quick UI tests | 1480 passed, 9 ignored; run from `crates/ui` |
| `camcraft-motion --test avoid_pocket` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test do_not_touch` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 1440 passed, 8 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | PASS: 246 steps, 0 failures, 0 stalls; 52.5 minutes |

The author body reports no heavy run. This review ran all reached heavy lanes on the trial merge above. No heavy result is owed for this reviewed tree. The detailed lane results follow below. Registered known-failure checks matched their expected assertions. They are gate passes, not unexpected test failures.

## Extra suites run

The quick gate selected these required catalog and golden suites. This review ran each complete suite.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| App `example_catalog` | 37 passed, 4 ignored in debug; all 4 ignored tests passed in heavy |
| App `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| App `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed |
| App `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| App `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| Motion `golden_undercut` | 4 passed |

No fixture directory or importer source changed. The extra fixture-reader and kernel STEP selections do not apply. No moved golden needs a line-by-line check.

## Safety mutation checks

Both mutations ran locally in the throwaway review worktree. Each original file was restored before its green run. The final worktree has no code changes.

1. Replace the overhead envelope's `p.clearance_z.max(z)` with `p.retract_z.unwrap_or(p.clearance_z).max(z)`. The test `pocket_avoid_keeps_final_clearance_lift_clear_of_overhead_obstacle` failed as expected:
   ```text
   AvoidHit { at: 95, item: 1, part: Holder, short_mm: 13.0 }
   ```
   Restore the file: the same test passed.
2. Remove `OpType::Pocket` from `do_not_touch_applies`. The test `pocket2d_do_not_touch_keeps_full_tool_clear_of_protected_face_and_edge` failed in `set_operation_do_not_touch`, as expected. Restore the file: the same test passed.

## Limits and notes

- Interactive GPU viewport rendering was not exercised. Structural UI tests passed. They do not supply the missing before/after screenshots.
- Batch and release-cut gates were not run. Quick and all reached heavy lanes ran locally.
- This review includes the stacked #3353 changes that remain in this PR's diff against main.
- The PR stays a draft and receives `needs-rework` for the two items above.
